headlines.description: Chelsea's winning start to life under Xabi Alonso continued with a pulsating 4-3 win over Brighton at Stamford Bridge.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chelsea dazzle in attack again to beat Brighton 4-3, but defensive frailties remain

headlines.description: Dominic Calvert-Lewin fired a late equaliser as Leeds fought back to salvage a 1-1 draw against Brentford in their opening home Premier League game of the season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dominic Calvert-Lewin scores late equaliser to salvage a 1-1 draw with Brentford at Elland Road

headlines.description: Sunderland claimed their first win of the season as they edged out Fulham 1-0 thanks to Wilson Isidor's goal, just days after he signed a new contract with the Black Cats.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sunderland get their first win of the season as Wilson Isidor strike seals 1-0 victory over Fulham

headlines.description: Bruno Fernandes' hat trick helped Manchester United bounce back from their humiliation against Hull City and a poor start against Ipswich to secure a 5-2 comeback victory on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fernandes nets hat trick as Man Utd rout Ipswich

headlines.description: Jude Bellingham scored a fine solo goal as Real Madrid continued their 100 per cent start to Jose Mourinho's second spell in charge by thrashing Malaga 4-0 in LaLiga.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jude Bellingham shines as Real Madrid thrash Malaga 4-0
